outcome.text: equivalent evidence reproduces one receipt and no interpretation becomes a decision

scenarioSurface.notes:
Interpretation evaluates evidence. Governance alone decides.

  This capability evaluates admitted product-fit snapshot references under one
  admitted strategic intent, expected product set, strategic-product mapping
  set, conservative interpretation profile, and bounded evidence window. It
  retains counterevidence, non-observable areas, applicability, provenance, and
  explicit limitations. It emits no organizational action and changes nothing.

strategicIntentAuthority.intent: Enable a person or organization to move from meaningful intent to proven executable capability with minimal semantic translation and implementation friction

mappingAuthority.domainStatement: Attributable governed model testimony may support the semantic-runway thesis within the exact admitted product and evidence scope

evaluationLaw: invalid, incomplete, duplicate, held, stale, or identity-divergent product evidence holds interpretation
held interpretation emits no interpretation disposition
interpretationPrecedence: no applicable expected product evidence yields STRATEGIC_EVIDENCE_NOT_APPLICABLE
any applicable PRODUCT_NOT_REINFORCED yields STRATEGIC_EVIDENCE_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_BOUNDED_SCOPE
otherwise any applicable PRODUCT_FIT_NOT_OBSERVABLE yields STRATEGIC_EVIDENCE_NOT_OBSERVABLE
only complete applicable PRODUCT_REINFORCED evidence yields STRATEGIC_EVIDENCE_SUPPORTS_BOUNDED_SCOPE
